correctness.rationale: For diagonal C6 action on Fermat sextic fourfold, g and g^5 have no fixed points. The order-three subgroup fixes 18 points on three coordinate lines, paired in nine C6 orbits, each with tangent quotient weights 1/3(1,1,2,2). The involution fixes two disjoint smooth Fermat plane sextics genus 10; residual free order-three action gives genus 4 for each coarse singular curve with tangent normal weights 1/2(1,1,1). The invariant cubic map [x:y:z]↦[x³:y³:z³:xyz] realizes each quotient as smooth canonical complete intersection U²+V²+W²=0, T³=UVW, genus four. Chern class [H^4](1+H)^6/(1+6H)=435, deg(X)=6, so e(X)=2610. Fixed euler data (2610,0,18,-36,18,0) give e(Y)=435; gcd-pair multiplicities (24,8,3,1) yield commuting-pair Euler 441. Independent exact integer check reproduced Chern coefficient, four invariant cubics, gcd multiplicities, Euler numbers; analytic proof supplies geometric local statements.
